initial_decision.brief_rationale: The numerical checks validate the computed contrast but do not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R138-2 to assess whether the standardized difference identifies the requested average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R138-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the causal effect by standardization over Z. The stratum risk differences are 0.9−0.9=0 and 0.6−0.8=−0.2. Each stratum contains half the population, yielding an average causal risk difference of −0.1.
